evidence.ACL: The contour of ACL & PCL appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
evidence.MCL: Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial and lateral meniscus , without significant extending into the surface, in favor of grade 2 intrasubstance signal of posterior horn of medial meniscus, maybe due to degeneration.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Linear signal intensity in anterior horn of lateral meniscus, with extending into the surface, R/O tear.
evidence.Medial OA: Wearing of articular cartilage and spur formation and mild subchondral edma over medial femoral condyle, in favor of degeneration.
evidence.Baker's: A lobulated cystic lesion in medial popliteal fossa between the tendons of the medial head of the gastrocnemius and the semimembranosus muscles, in favor of Baker's cyst
evidence.Contusion: No evidence of bone contusion is noted.
